headline: Rams 28-6 Giants: Los Angeles cruises on Monday Night as Dart exits
whyCareReason: The Rams rebound from Melbourne to claim their first win of 2026 with a commanding 28-6 victory, closing Week 2 as Jaxson Dart exits with a knee injury.
teaser: FINAL: Rams 28, Giants 6. Stafford tosses two touchdowns, defense locks down SoFi Stadium. Week 2 of the NFL season is in the book.
story:
Why this one matters: Week 2 featured shootouts, overtime thrillers, and stadium openers. Monday night at SoFi Stadium closed the week with defensive authority as the Rams secured their first win, 28-6.

Sky Sports and NFL.com report a dominant first half by Los Angeles. The Rams jumped out to an early two-touchdown lead behind Matthew Stafford's precision passing. New York suffered a pivotal blow when rookie quarterback Jaxson Dart left the contest with a knee injury.

The Rams defense never let the Giants back into rhythm, allowing only two field goals across four quarters. With the victory, Los Angeles moves to 1-1 and drops New York to 1-1, officially closing the 16-game Week 2 ledger.
stakes: The Rams avoid an 0-2 hole, while the Giants face immediate questions surrounding Dart's health heading into Week 3.
rivalryAngle: Two historic NFC franchises meet under the bright lights of Monday Night Football in Southern California.
